slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to ChatGPT, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship assistant for chat, writing, coding, data analysis, and image generation.
The free tier now includes capable models, web browsing, and limited image generation.
Plus and Pro unlock the most advanced reasoning models, higher limits, and features like advanced voice and deep research.
slides.narration: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship assistant for chat, writing, coding, data analysis, and image generation. The free tier now includes capable models, web browsing, and limited image generation. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: generate differentiated reading passages, draft IEP goal language (then review every line), or build a quiz with an answer key
SMB owners: write job descriptions, analyze a CSV of expenses, or generate product photos for a listing
Community leaders: draft a grant narrative, turn a survey into talking points, or brainstorm event names
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can generate differentiated reading passages, draft IEP goal language (then review every line), or build a quiz with an answer key; SMB owners can write job descriptions, analyze a CSV of expenses, or generate product photos for a listing; Community leaders can draft a grant narrative, turn a survey into talking points, or brainstorm event names.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
